capabilities: sync Memos server entries into daily notes incrementally
force resync all memos from the server
resync memos for a specific day's note
create missing daily notes and insert memos under a configured header
store synced attachments in a configurable folder
extras: Supports both Memos API versions (after v0.22.0 and before); daily note template must contain the configured header or syncing fails.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull memos from a Memos server into daily notes.

relations.evidence: The code in obsidian-lifeos provides a lot of reference value in the early stages of this project.

summary: Syncs memos from a Memos server into Obsidian daily notes, with incremental and forced syncing and automatic daily note creation.
